title: Grade 2 French — Wed, Jun 11
description: Les animaux — Day 3 of 5: Sea and water animals
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'a fish' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un poisson' = a fish. 'Le poisson nage dans l'eau.' = The fish swims in the water.

questions.question: What is 'une baleine' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Une baleine' = a whale. 'La baleine est le plus grand animal marin.' = The whale is the largest sea animal.

questions.question: How do you say 'a dolphin' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un dauphin' = a dolphin. 'Le dauphin est très intelligent.' = The dolphin is very intelligent.

questions.question: What is 'un requin' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un requin' = a shark. 'Le requin a de grandes dents.' = The shark has big teeth.

questions.question: How do you say 'a crab' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un crabe' = a crab. 'Le crabe marche de côté.' = The crab walks sideways.

questions.question: What is 'une tortue de mer' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Une tortue de mer' = a sea turtle. 'La tortue de mer nage très bien.' = The sea turtle swims very well.

questions.question: What is 'une étoile de mer' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Une étoile de mer' = a starfish. 'Étoile' = star; 'mer' = sea.

questions.question: How do you say 'an octopus' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un poulpe' = an octopus. 'Le poulpe a huit tentacules.' = The octopus has eight tentacles.

questions.question: Where do sea animals live? 'Les animaux marins vivent ___.'
options: Dans la mer ou l'océan (in the sea or ocean)
questions.explanation: 'Les animaux marins vivent dans la mer ou l'océan.' = Sea animals live in the sea or ocean.

questions.question: What is 'une méduse' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Une méduse' = a jellyfish. 'La méduse flotte dans l'eau.' = The jellyfish floats in the water.

questions.question: Match: un poisson nage, un oiseau ___, un chien ___.
questions.explanation: 'Un oiseau vole.' = A bird flies. 'Un chien court.' = A dog runs. Each animal has its own movement verb.

questions.question: How do you say 'I see a dolphin' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je vois un dauphin.' = I see a dolphin. 'Voir' (je vois) = to see.

questions.question: Which animal is NOT a sea animal? 'Lequel n'est pas un animal marin?'
questions.explanation: 'Le loup' (wolf) is a wild land animal, not a sea animal. Les autres (others) — dauphin, requin, baleine — vivent dans la mer.

questions.question: Complete: 'Le ___ est grand et nage dans l'océan.' (The whale is big and swims in the ocean.)
questions.explanation: 'La baleine est grande et nage dans l'océan.' = The whale is big and swims in the ocean. Note: 'baleine' is feminine (la/une).

questions.question: Review: Name the 3 categories of animals we learned this week. 'Les animaux ___.'
options: de la forêt / du ciel / du désert
questions.explanation: This week: animaux domestiques (domestic), animaux sauvages (wild), animaux marins (sea). Three animal worlds!
